name: @opal/runner
description: Opal Code runner: connects a machine to Opal and runs coding agents on it.

scripts.appimage: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 -f appimage/Dockerfile --output type=local,dest=dist .
scripts.appimage:x64: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -f appimage/Dockerfile --output type=local,dest=dist .
